meaning.zh:
“出乎意料” 或 “最了不起” 或 “糟糕透顶”。

这个短语源自于19世纪美国的选美比赛，优胜者会获得一个蛋糕作为奖品。在现代英语中，“take the cake” 则被用来表示某事非常出色或令人震惊，有时也带有讽刺意味，用来指某事极其糟糕。
meaning.en: This idiom originates from 19th-century American beauty contests where the winner would receive a cake as a prize. In modern English, "take the cake" is used to denote something outstanding or surprising, sometimes with a sarcastic tone to indicate something is extremely bad.

lines.en: Her performance truly *takes the cake*; it was amazing!
lines.zh: 她的表演真的太了不起了；简直令人惊叹！

lines.en: Out of all the mistakes, that one really *takes the cake*.
lines.zh: 在所有的错误中，那一个真是最糟糕的。

lines.en: I’ve heard some excuses before, but this one *takes the cake*.
lines.zh: 我以前听过一些借口，但这个真是出乎意料。
